facts: PLFS is run by the National Statistics Office (MoSPI); its first round covered 2017–18.
UNSC non-permanent members serve two-year terms and need two-thirds of GA members present and voting.
India's CPI target is 4% (band 2–6%), set by the Centre with RBI under Section 45ZA.
ESA's Proba-3 makes an artificial eclipse with two satellites flying about 150 m apart.
The Living Planet Index is compiled by the Zoological Society of London with WWF.

mcqs.s: Non-permanent members of the UN Security Council are elected for two years and are not eligible for immediate re-election.
Aditya-L1 orbits the Sun–Earth L1 point, about 1.5 million km from Earth.
mcqs.why: It sits in a halo orbit around L1, facing the Sun without eclipses.
